odc_type: incorrect calendar arithmetic handling of year zero
observation_summary: An IllegalFieldValueException is thrown when performing date arithmetic that crosses the year zero boundary.
reasoning_summary: The defect arises because the Joda-Time library uses a calendar system that does not support a 'year zero' (it skips from 1 BC to 1 AD). When performing date arithmetic (like adding or subtracting years) across the Gregorian-Julian cutover, the internal calculations can result in a year value of zero, which is invalid and triggers an IllegalFieldValueException. The fix involves explicitly checking if the resulting year is zero after an arithmetic operation and adjusting it by one year to correctly skip the non-existent year zero, ensuring the transition between BC and AD is handled correctly.
